prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Two Column Path Overview with Preset Previews: Redesigns the choose path screen into a split two-column card comparison separating quick premade adoption from custom photo creation. (why: The choose_path step has a huge gap between median time (8s) and mean time (514s) with a 23.8% drop-off, showing users get stuck deciding.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Pet Creation Selection: Moves the sign-in screen to after pet picking so users establish emotional investment before creating an account. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users right near the start of the funnel.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Data Sync Warning on Sign In: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen explaining account synchronization. (why: 8 support emails (the largest support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in with a different or existing account.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Generation Fallback Option Hint: Displays a hint on photo upload providing assurance and standard template fallback options. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpectedly.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status in Waiting Screen: Displays time estimate and progress status during initialization to reassure users that the desktop pet is loading. (why: 3 support tickets noted the pet did not show on desktop, and the waiting/home median time is 201s (mean 2336s).)
5: [choose_path, incentive] Instant Play Path Highlight: Adds a quick setup badge highlight on the choose_path screen. (why: The choose_path step drop-off is 23.8% and users spend a mean of 514s on it.)
6: [finish, notification] Ready Notification Toggle for Initialization Completion: Adds an option to notify the user when pet setup and initialization finish. (why: Finish step has a very long mean time of 5815s, indicating users minimize or abandon the app while waiting.)
7: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Certificate Preview: Changes adoption certificate to split screen layout highlighting the official pet adoption seal. (why: 39.1% of users drop off during the adoption step.)

scores.note: Targets 23.8% choose_path drop-off; redesign requires new screen layout.
Addresses 27.1% sign-in drop-off by reordering steps, requiring flow changes.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in drop-off; low cost copy change.
Targets largest step drop-off (39.1%) backed by 3 support tickets.
Addresses high median wait time and desktop visibility support emails.
Simple UI highlight config to help users decide faster at choose_path.
Addresses extreme mean wait time on finish step (5815s) with notifications.
Targets high adoption drop-off but redesign evidence remains thin.
